units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of AC unit, window and table regions vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.03 px in every frame)
camera.view: fronto-parallel view of a blue wall; table front edge is horizontal; falling motion is in a plane facing the camera

potted_plant.description: small white flower pot (light grey rim band) with a pale yellow-green succulent/rosette on top; the only moving object
potted_plant.reference_point: mask_cx, mask_cy = centroid of the segmented pot+plant; bbox_cx/bbox_cy = bbox centre. The pot bottom edge y1 is the most robust coordinate during the fall (white pot vs wall); top y0 loses a few px of pale leaf tips on the light wall in frames ~6-14

size_resting_upright_px.note: frame 15 (just landed, upright): bbox x 1044-1089, y 810-868 (h 59, leaf tips partly lost); frame 0 value 67 px is the better full height

potted_plant.motion_summary: hangs/starts at top centre (x~1066) at frame 0, falls straight down (x constant within 1 px) to the table top, lands at frame 15, then rocks side to side on its base without leaving the table (tilts right to max at frame 21, back through upright ~frame 26, tilts left to max ~frame 32, back through upright ~frame 38, tilting right again at frame 39)

table.description: long dark-wood/black-metal console table along the wall, glossy top that mirrors the pot
table.legs: left leg x 680-704, right leg x ~1500-1507 (plus white metal trim to ~1535); legs run off the bottom of the frame

ac_unit.description: white LG outdoor air-conditioner unit with a round fan grille, bottom-left, behind the table's left end
ac_unit.fan_grille: approx x 150-400, y 785-1065 (circular fan ~250 px dia)

notebook_with_pen.description: dark notebook with a silver/black pen lying on it, on the table left of the pot

phone.description: black smartphone lying flat on the table right of the pot

window.description: white-framed window in the side wall at the right edge

wall.description: textured blue wall background, lit brighter in the middle

events.note: bottom-edge y steps: +4 px (0->1), +11 (1->2), +17 (2->3): starts essentially from rest at frame 0
frame 14 bottom y=770, frame 15 bottom y=868 (resting on table); contact between frames 14 and 15, at or just before frame 15
bottom stays at y 867-868 from frame 15 to 39; the pot rocks on its base instead

events.event: rocking: max tilt right (centroid x max 1082.3)
rocking: max tilt left (centroid x min 1050.6)
